text: Tether | Product Engineering Lead, Keet | REMOTE (Worldwide) We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to help build and scale Keet, a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app. You'll lead API and frontend engineering teams, working closely with Product to turn the roadmap into high-quality features. We're looking for someone with: - Experience leading engineering teams building consumer products. - Strong JavaScript and React skills. - Solid product sense and technical leadership. - Understanding of distributed, local-first or P2P systems. Apply: https://tether.recruitee.com/o/product-engineering-lead-keet...
